## MKCinema 1.1: Smart TV

MKCinema now runs on your TV.

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` | Android TV 7 or later |
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (the same file) | Android 7 or later |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | webOS 4 or later, Developer Mode or Homebrew Channel |
| Windows, macOS, Linux | unchanged from 1.0 | |

### On a TV
- Browse with the arrows and OK. Back closes what's open, then goes Home, then exits.
- Play/pause, rewind, fast-forward and next work from the remote's media keys.
- **Fire TV:** install Downloader, allow it under Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options, then enter `mkcinema-site.pages.dev/tv`.
- **Android TV / Google TV:** install Downloader from Google Play, allow unknown sources for it, then enter the same address.

Samsung TVs aren't supported yet: Samsung only installs apps signed through its developer program.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
